entry.title: Resolution 431 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO NORTH KOHALA COMMUNITY RESOURCE CENTER TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE KING KAMEHAMEHA DAY CELEBRATION

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 431.25 - 01/07/26
